question_text: Explain why a wireless field sensor may upload data more slowly at the edge of coverage than near its access point.
adaptation_rationale: Wireless bandwidth, range, attenuation and reliability factors are explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Longer distance causes signal attenuation, increasing errors/retransmissions or forcing a lower data rate, reducing effective throughput.

marking_points.criterion: Weaker signal increases errors/retransmission or lowers link rate.
Connects this to lower useful throughput.
